served: video-EEG monitoring of a typical event
results: 1. genetic testing (exome / epilepsy panel): missense variant in exon 4 of CSNK2B (NM_001320.7 c.268A>C, p.Thr90Pro), likely pathogenic by ACMG; threonine 90 is evolutionarily conserved
2. video-EEG monitoring of a typical event: eyelid myoclonia with absences - the Jeavons phenotype
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: CSNK2B-related epilepsy (Poirier–Bienvenu neurodevelopmental syndrome) presenting with Jeavons syndrome—eyelid myoclonia with absences—caused by the likely pathogenic heterozygous CSNK2B c.268A>C (p.Thr90Pro) variant

ALTERNATIVE: Jeavons syndrome (epilepsy with eyelid myoclonia) without an identifiable syndromic cause

ALTERNATIVE: Other genetic generalized epilepsy with absence seizures and eyelid myoclonia

ALTERNATIVE: CSNK2B-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with a Jeavons-like phenotype
